text:
deploybot: Deploy pause triggered for rollout 2026-03-19_omega due to incident #4287 (auth 503s in eu-west-1). Holding queued slots and adding to waitlist. Owners: @sasha @aaron. Please confirm rollback vs reschedule.

aaron: Oncall here — thanks for the flag. Incident still seeing 503s across controlplane, ETA ~30m to stabilize. Recommend hold and move to next window, not safe to roll forward.

sasha: Agree with hold. No config changes in this rollout, so I vote no rollback for now. Suggest pin release to last stable (1.12.1) until we confirm infra healthy.

maya: Product note — if we postpone we need a short customer-facing line. Draft: "Scheduled upgrade postponed due to service incident; new ETA TBD." I can post to status once schedule is confirmed.

jamie: Ops question — preferred reschedule window? Can we move to tomorrow 00:30-02:00 UTC? That avoids EU morning. Also propose reducing canary batch size (batch=4 -> batch=2) for the retry.

aaron: 00:30 UTC tomorrow works for SRE. Also add an automatic fallback: if canary error rate >5% then rollback to 1.12.1. We should pin now.

sasha: I'll pin in the console: `redwoodctl rollout pin --release 2026-03-19_omega --version 1.12.1` and mark rollout as paused.

deploybot: Rollout 2026-03-19_omega pinned to 1.12.1 by sasha. Schedule moved to 2026-03-20T00:30:00Z by aaron. Canary batch size updated to 2. Release state: PAUSED (manual resume only).

maya: Thanks — I'll draft the customer note and loop in marketing for signoff. ETA ~20m.

jamie: Adding cross-ref: <https://incidents.redwood.ai/4287|incident-4287>. Please include that in the release notes and audit. Also add a runbook step to warm KV caches after deploy.

ops-bot: Audit log entry created: rollout=2026-03-19_omega pinned_by=sasha at=4448890100 schedule_set_by=aaron tags=[incident-4287, rollout-pause].

aaron: If the incident resolves faster than expected we will NOT auto-resume. Manual smoke tests required first, then manual unpause.

sasha: Added a short checklist to the rollout notes: smoke test cmds, rollback snippet, contacts (oncall + platform eng).

jamie: Request product include a short blurb on the status page with tentative reschedule and link to support docs. @maya

maya: On it — will update status page and ping sales with the draft once ready.
